title: ResonateEngine host manifest
description: The capabilities the host itself provides, before any module is loaded. A module may require these; nothing may provide them again. scripts/module_check.lua holds the other half of that rule.

id.description: Identity of the host itself, unique among modules.

name.description: Display name for logs and editor lists.

abi.description: Major ABI version the host implements.

summary.description: One line describing the host's own capabilities.

provides.description: Capabilities the host publishes. Each must be declared by a capability header.

items.description: Capability name, as it appears in CapabilityTraits<T>::id.
